title: Fox's vision of Tim Coleman keying his car
place_text: editing building for Out of the Blue

tellings.quote: editing I get a visual image in my head I see him with a key clear as day

plain: While editing his documentary Out of the Blue, the filmmaker James Fox says a picture suddenly came into his head of a man named Tim Coleman holding a key, "clear as day," scratching his car. Fox tells Michels this happened to him in the editing building, and he tells it as a moment of sensing something he had not seen with his eyes.
